images.prompt: Completely new full-bleed square Reading Tree cover scene, using the Jupiter cover as the exact vehicle-and-cast design reference: the same girl, younger boy and small young Papillon Vanilla ride inside the same cream bowl-shaped bubble ship with broad riveted brass rim, round brass portholes, small fins and one clear hemispherical canopy. The ship flies low above Valles Marineris, which reads as a vast deep system of layered rust-red cliffs, branching chasms, terraces and shadowed depths. Across the far horizon, Olympus Mons reads as an enormous very wide, low, gently sloped shield volcano with a broad flattened summit and visible caldera, never a pointed mountain. Dusty butterscotch-pink sky; soft classic watercolour; natural hands; Vanilla has exactly two butterfly ears; no planet globe or disc, Earth, starfield, observatory, room, telescope, text, labels, borders or malformed anatomy.
